statement: 目标 Windows 环境包含 Microsoft YaHei
Existing pure core behavior should remain unchanged during UI migration
Qt offscreen is useful but insufficient for Windows visual acceptance
PySide6 can be packaged with an acceptable onefile user experience
validation: EXP-001（EVD-QT-003）实测：onefile 热启动 2.903s，超出 performance-budgets 的 warm_start_seconds p95 ≤2.5s；onedir 0.685s。假设被证伪，ADR-0004 据此选定 onedir。另有独立理由：LGPL-3.0 §4(d) 的重链接义务在 onefile 下无法履行。
